items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 10:05pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 10:05pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Clear spells, with a slight frost in places around dawn and a small risk of icy patches. Minimum temperature 0°C on higher ground and in the central valley.

Sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving around midnight, falling as snow on hills. Fresh northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later in evening. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Outlook##

Rain through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground before temperatures rise. Minimum temperature 1°C .

Rain persisting for much of the day, turning heavy at times, before clearing later. Strong to gale force east winds gradually easing. Top temperature 10°C.

7:47am Tomorrow

4:17pm Tomorrow
